stemMd: For x not equal to 3, simplify (x squared minus 9)/(x−3).

options.label: B
options.textMd: x+3 for all real x, including 3

explanationMd: Factor the numerator as (x−3)(x+3), then cancel the nonzero factor x−3. The original domain restriction remains even though the simplified formula itself has a value at 3.

distractorRationale.b: The original expression remains undefined at 3.
distractorRationale.c: Factoring does not preserve the squared term this way.
distractorRationale.d: The numerator and denominator are not identical.
